strings.mdKbSmart: • Kiʻi pahu kī akamai: nānā i ka pahu kī o kēia manawa me ka papa inoa hoʻopau ʻana o Google (CRL) a hoʻāʻo i nā kumu he nui a hiki i ka loaʻa ʻana o kahi pahu kī kūpono, me kahi hoʻihoʻi ʻakomi a hoʻomaka hou i nā lawelawe Google. Holo i kēlā me kēia pā a pono i ka pūnaewele (1-3 mau minuke).
strings.mdKbNet: • Pahu kī mai ka pūnaewele: hoʻoiho i kahi pahu kī mai ka waihona kūhelu (GitHub) a mālama iā ia i /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Pono pūnaewele a lawe i 1-3 mau minuke. Hoʻohana ʻia i ka wā i hāʻule ʻole ai ke kiʻi akamai a i ʻole i hoʻololi lima ʻia ka pahu kī.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP hōʻoia: nānā i nā modules Remote Key Provisioning i loaʻa, nānā i ka mana TEE palapala hōʻoia, a hōʻike i ke kūlana mea hana KmInstallKeybox. ʻAʻohe mea e hoʻololi - he hiʻohiʻona kūlana maʻalahi.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine nānā (heluhelu-wale): hōʻike i nā hōʻailona pae Widevine (L1/L3) mai dumpsys, DRM (IDM) kiʻi waihona, a me nā waiwai pūnaewele pili. Hoʻololi iki i kekahi mea.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: holo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Hoʻoponopono i nā pilikia o ka hōʻoia ʻana ke hāʻule ʻole ka holo ʻakomi. Paʻi ʻia kēlā me kēia holo i kahi laina kūleʻa / hāʻule ʻole.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Hoʻoponopono piha RKP: holo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh piha. Mālama i nā hihia paʻakikī a lōʻihi. Hōʻike ʻia kahi hopena maopopo ma ka hopena.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Hoʻoponopono hou i ka GMS: hoʻomaʻemaʻe i ka ʻikepili Play Store a me Google (GMS+GSF) a hoʻomaka hou i ka hāmeʻa. No ka hōʻoia paʻakikī wale nō - ʻaʻole ia e hoʻopā i kāu mau kiʻi a i ʻole nā ​​faila.
strings.mdCertify: • Pāʻani hōʻoia: nānā i ke kūlana hōʻoia palapala RKP o ka mea hana a hoʻoponopono hou i nā waiwai hōʻoia inā pono. ʻAʻole pili i ka ʻikepili mea hoʻohana.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER hoʻoponopono: hoʻoponopono i nā pilikia Google (SOTER) e pili ana i ka hōʻoia ʻana o ka mea hana. Hoʻohana ʻia no kekahi mau polokalamu e hilinaʻi ana ma SOTER ma kahi o Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • E noi PIF: holo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh ikaika. Hoʻopili i ka manamana lima i koho ʻia (kaʻāina/mua) a hōʻano hou i nā faila pif.prop/pif.json. Hōʻike ʻia kahi hopena maopopo ma ka log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF nānā: hōʻike i ke kūlana ʻenekini i hoʻokomo ʻia, nā faila manamana lima (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), a me nā lāʻau. E nānā wale - ʻaʻohe mea e hoʻololi.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: holo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. E kiʻi i ka hoʻokuʻu hou ʻana o Canary Engine e hōʻoia i ka hoʻokō ʻana me nā palapala kauoha RKP (Feberuari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • ʻIke ʻenekini: nānā i ka mokuʻāina TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), nā faila pahu kī (active vs user), ka manamana lima maoli vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP kī. Hōʻike hōʻike diagnostic wale nō.
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ E paipai i ke kula kiʻekiʻe → mua
strings.hintKbSlots: Mālama ka module i ʻelua mau pahu pahu kī: ka mea mua (laʻa, ʻaʻole holoi ʻia) a me ka lua (backup). Hōʻike kēia ʻaoʻao i ka slot e hana ana, hoʻololi i ka makemake, a i ʻole hoʻolaha i ke kula kiʻekiʻe i ka mea mua ma ke noi kikoʻī - me nā backup a me kahi log piha.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • ʻIke pono: nānā i ka lawe ʻana mai o ke kī TEE, ka hoʻokomo ʻana o ka waihona i loko o keystore2, ke kūlana hoʻopau (CRL), ka uhi papa inoa palekana a me ka mokuʻāina RKP. Heluhelu wale — ʻaʻohe mea e hoʻololi.
